title: Jannatak iroh qidim
intro: cuumi le gino giti tabaatabuk solta hadliyyi kee cinna. ken aydaadi qeedalsime sinni kaxxiinaa kee ellecaboh qibaadah amrih sadi. ken doorit kulli horal qagaaqagitak, ta baadal yooboke kulli roocih aqayyaare yakke. Atu tama amotani naqboyta baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu kosmik maqnisso le tekkookat geytima, qusba gino kallaytak bicteeh, Racmatta le ufuy manoh tecee wak.
Anu innih manol baahe dubuk yan girah liyyitte, too qaanek baxsa luk.
amri yoh yeceen too anu inni guddaaqak gubal akkale.
kaxxiini addat yok duddubeeh, anu woo amri yassakaxxeenim diggaluk cineh.
xagni ayro fanah udurra yoh teceeh, tonnal anu inni hadaf kataatam duudah gersi mara hoxah.
Anu ardi bagul gexa marak inkih naqboyti kinniyo, aylahsiyyi tutucto kee massat yan gitak ken yayyaaqeenimi.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
